_what: Jobs the owners may turn on or off, or run now, from chat (switches.py, the `switch` tool). A job names a true/false field in one config file and/or the Windows Scheduled Task registered from this repository (the registry is the allow-list; the bridge enables, disables or starts it, nothing more). Add a job here, never in code.

jobs.name: YouTube Scout
jobs.what: nightly at 1:30 AM: one YouTube video of 30 minutes or more, fact-checked into the wiki, ideas as cards

jobs.name: Dreaming
jobs.what: 6:30 AM daily: memory consolidation from the day's logs, self-improvement, wiki ingest

jobs.name: Day Spine
jobs.what: every 10 minutes 06:00-23:30: the standing jobs that keep the day moving (follow-ups, reminders, sentinels, builds)

jobs.name: Comms Probe
jobs.what: every minute 07:00-21:30: wakes the operator within a minute of a text, email, lead or tap

jobs.name: Operator (tick)
jobs.what: every 30 minutes 07:45-21:45: the operator works its ticket queue

jobs.name: Drive to Wiki
jobs.what: hourly 06:20-23:20: new Google Drive documents from both accounts into Raw/Drive and the wiki

jobs.name: Ad Scout
jobs.what: 7:30 AM daily: Google Ads stats and leads in, the weekly budget proposal and challenger ads (proposal only, never spends)

jobs.name: Optimization Scout
jobs.what: 3:30 AM nightly: read-only scout for ways to improve the system

jobs.name: ShareGrid Tracker
jobs.what: weekly: gear rental price tracking on ShareGrid

jobs.name: YouTube Ingest
jobs.what: the older YouTube transcript ingest pipeline (dormant unless switched on)
